rounds.name: Constructive Speeches
rounds.purpose: Frame motion, define parameters, present substantive cases 1 & 2

rounds.name: Cross-Examination / POI Arena
rounds.purpose: Targeted interrogations with strict floor rights and direct answer requirements

rounds.name: Rebuttal Speeches
rounds.purpose: Direct clash on core substantive points; defense of original framework

rounds.name: Defense & Consolidation
rounds.purpose: Deep textual defense, historical substantiation, exposure of opponents' structural fallacies

rounds.name: Whip / Summary Speeches
rounds.purpose: Crystallized clash summary; zero new arguments permitted

prohibitions: Defend or attack a team on its own behalf
Inject personal, partisan, or doctrinal opinions
Replace a human debater or act as P4/C4 in competitive matches
Favor one team's case over the other

modes.live_match: AI is strictly supervisory; 6 human debaters required
modes.training_sparring: AI Debater acts as synthetic sparring partner (Persona Zuma)

dimensions.name: Matter
dimensions.description: Depth of argument, factual accuracy, textual evidence grounding

dimensions.name: Manner
dimensions.description: Persuasiveness, rhetorical control, composure, professional delivery

dimensions.name: Method
dimensions.description: Structural coherence, time allocation, team role fulfillment

dimensions.name: Logic & Reasoning
dimensions.description: Absence of fallacies, valid deductive/inductive soundness

dimensions.name: Cross-Examination & Responsiveness
dimensions.description: Directness in answering, precision in questioning

dimensions.name: Clash & Rebuttal
dimensions.description: Success in engaging and neutralizing opposing core arguments

referee_sanctions.description: Recorded in match ledger, displayed on UI
Gross ad-hominem, hate speech, or sustained insubordination

sources: Biblical manuscripts (Codex Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, Papyri P46, P66, P75, DSS)
Explicit lexical or syntactic clauses directly addressing the motion
Patristic commentaries, peer-reviewed academic monographs, academic lexicons (BDB, HALOT, BDAG)

winner_determination.mechanism: Highest cumulative net score across all 3 debaters after deducting referee penalties
